name: Ethlow
source:
Welcome to the district of Ehtlow!! Follow Clive Archer and his blossoming romance with a mobster who takes an interest in him after one fateful meeting.

[From [url=https://loony-pendulum.itch.io/ethlow]itch.io[/url]]

Side story for the [url=https://sites.google.com/view/ai-v-ai/home]AI V AI comic[/url].
translation:
歡迎來到埃斯洛區！一次偶遇後，一名黑幫成員對克萊夫．阿徹產生了興趣。跟隨克萊夫，看看這段戀情怎樣漸漸萌芽。
